question: Perform autofocus, measure a spectrum once, apply IPBSA baseline correction with order 5, and report the peaks found (prominence 5% of range).
criteria: PROC(args EXACT) + SET(peak ±3 cm-1) / post-hoc GT
answer_text:
Based on the acquisition and processing steps, a single Raman spectrum was obtained at (37.876, 25.248) with a laser power of 15% and an exposure time of 0.2 seconds. The signal was then processed using iterative polynomial background subtraction (IPBSA) with a fifth-order polynomial to remove fluorescence background.

Analysis of the corrected spectrum revealed that no peaks met the requirement of having a prominence of at least 5% of the total dynamic range. This may be due to the broad nature of the features or the specific thresholding criteria.
